transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly disposition board review. We have three items listed as excess today: generator G-14, tablet set T-22, and electric pallet jack P-6. Before I close the board record, I need current status from each of you — property, supply, and maintenance — on all three items. Please go ahead and walk us through where each one stands.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I received a higher-headquarters allocation message this morning directing generator G-14 to transfer to the 14th Engineer Company, and the transfer must be recorded against that unit's property account. I haven't entered it into the battalion disposition spreadsheet yet, but that's the disposition for G-14.

transcript.text: I need to flag tablet set T-22. During this morning's count, I found a confirmed serial-number mismatch between the physical devices and the property book. Because of that discrepancy, T-22 must be placed on property reconciliation hold — it cannot be transferred or turned in until the mismatch is resolved. The discrepancy worksheet is still being checked by our supply clerks, so there's ongoing coordination on that front.

transcript.text: I need to provide the maintenance status on electric pallet jack P-6. P-6 failed its hydraulic pressure inspection today and requires a maintenance hold until the shop completes a repair assessment. I signed the inspection log today, but the maintenance-status update has not yet been posted to the disposition board. So P-6 cannot be transferred or turned in until that repair assessment is complete.
